description.en: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分
description.zh: 在设置页编辑 prompt-inject.md、管理 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 规则集、检查插件更新，并对本机包做可回滚的应用或还原。

description.en: Rewrites a composer draft into a clearer, structured prompt (5 modes, model fallback chain, optional multi-round memory) and adds stop-on-silence, hotkey and filler-word cleanup to DSH voice input; transcription stays with the official speechToText, the plugin ships no engine.
description.zh: 把输入框草稿改写为更清晰、结构化的提示词（5 模式·模型回退链·可选多轮记忆），并为 DSH 语音输入加上说完自动停、热键与口水词清理；识别仍由官方 speechToText 提供，插件不自带引擎。

description.en: DSH插件：养一个会自己刷b站会成长的agent：不通过面板配置，通过学习诞生人格。
description.zh: 养一个会自己刷B站、自己思考成长的AI宠物，不靠人设配置，人格从学习中自然长出来。

description.en: DocsMint workspace panel and agent tools for document search, reading, creation and updates through Cloud OAuth or self-hosted API keys.
description.zh: DocsMint 工作区面板与智能体工具，支持文档搜索、读取、创建和更新，可连接 Cloud OAuth 或自托管 API 密钥。

description.en: Describe a small game in one sentence, play it in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, swap in AI art, export one HTML file.
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Parametric CAD kernel for LLMs: spec-driven geometry, measured facts, three-state verification, Blender-backed delivery
description.zh: 让大模型用自然语言驱动参数化建模，自动生成可验证的 CAD 零件并交付到 Blender。

description.en: A DSH plugin that explicitly designs LLM agent orchestration as a control loop
description.zh: 把 LLM 智能体的编排当成控制回路来设计，让多智能体协作更可控、可调。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：超级搜索 toolkit——集成 TinyFish 结构化检索、AnySearch REST、Bing 免 Key 爬取、Jina 与 DuckDuckGo，接管 DSH 原生 web_search，零 Token 消耗。
description.zh: 用免费搜索通道接管 DSH 原生 web_search，零 Token 消耗，省钱又省心。

description.en: For the DSH Go phone app (https://go.dshtui.com): watches the quiz screen and pushes each answer as a heads-up notification, using an optional local answer bank.
description.zh: DSH Go 手机 App 专用插件（官网 https://go.dshtui.com）：盯住手机上的考试/答题页面，把每道题的答案弹成顶部通知，可选导入本地题库优先命中。

description.en: Drive GridCraft from the agent: build workbooks, write and evaluate formulas, format ranges, insert charts and tables, and read cells back. Exposes both GridCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a workbook can be created and inspected end to end. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 GridCraft：构建工作簿、写入并计算公式、设置区域格式、插入图表与表格，并读回单元格。同时暴露 GridCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可端到端地创建并检查工作簿。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive TextureCraft from the agent: build texture sets and layers over a mesh, paint, bake maps, and export PBR textures. Exposes both TextureCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 TextureCraft：在网格上构建贴图集与图层、绘制、烘焙贴图，并导出 PBR 纹理。同时暴露 TextureCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive LightCraft from the agent: import photos, apply develop settings, and export JPEG or other formats from a photo library. Exposes LightCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 LightCraft：导入照片、应用冲图设置，并从照片库导出 JPEG 等格式。暴露 LightCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive EffectCraft from the agent: build compositions, add layers, set properties and keyframes, evaluate expressions, then render frames or movies. Exposes EffectCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 EffectCraft：搭建合成、添加图层、设置属性与关键帧、计算表达式，并渲染单帧或视频。暴露 EffectCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive CADCraft from the agent: draw lines, arcs and splines, manage layers, add dimensions, hatches and blocks, then export DXF, DWG, SVG, PNG or PDF. Exposes both CADCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a drawing can be created and read back. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 CADCraft：绘制直线、圆弧与样条，管理图层，添加标注、填充与图块，并导出 DXF、DWG、SVG、PNG 或 PDF。同时暴露 CADCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可创建并读回图纸。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DeckCraft from the agent: create slides, apply layouts and themes, add shapes, pictures, tables and charts, then save a .pptx or export a PDF. Exposes DeckCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DeckCraft：新建幻灯片、套用版式与主题、添加形状、图片、表格与图表，并保存为 .pptx 或导出 PDF。暴露 DeckCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FigCraft from the agent: create frames, components and auto layout, set fills, strokes and effects, build prototypes, and export PNG, SVG, PDF or code. Exposes both FigCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FigCraft：创建画框、组件与自动布局，设置填充、描边与效果，搭建原型，并导出 PNG、SVG、PDF 或代码。同时暴露 FigCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PdfCraft from the agent: read and extract text, render pages to images, rotate, delete, reorder, combine or split pages, and audit faux redactions. Exposes PdfCraft's tool set as both commands and an MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PdfCraft：读取并提取文本、把页面渲染成图片、旋转/删除/重排/合并/拆分页面，并检查伪脱敏。以命令与 MCP server 两种形式暴露 PdfCraft 的工具集。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PhotoCraft from the agent: open and create documents, work with layers and selections, apply adjustments and filters, run batch actions, then save or export PSD, PNG, JPG, TIFF or WebP. Exposes PhotoCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PhotoCraft：打开与新建文档、操作图层与选区、应用调整与滤镜、执行批处理动作，并保存或导出 PSD、PNG、JPG、TIFF 或 WebP。暴露 PhotoCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive VectorCraft from the agent: create and edit paths and artboards, set text and effects, then export SVG, PDF, AI or EPS. Exposes VectorCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 VectorCraft：创建与编辑路径和画板、设置文字与效果，并导出 SVG、PDF、AI 或 EPS。暴露 VectorCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FilmCraft from the agent: build a project and sequences, import media, run edits as a script, then export with a preset or format. Exposes FilmCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FilmCraft：创建工程与序列、导入素材、以脚本方式执行剪辑，并按预设或格式导出。暴露 FilmCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DesignCraft from the agent: create pages, place and flow text, arrange frames and master pages, then export PDF. Exposes DesignCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DesignCraft：创建页面、置入与排布文字、组织图文框与主页，并导出 PDF。暴露 DesignCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive SoundCraft from the agent: load a session, set track and mixer levels, insert plugins, edit MIDI, and bounce audio without opening a window. Exposes the DAW's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 SoundCraft：加载工程、设置轨道与混音电平、插入插件、编辑 MIDI，并在不打开窗口的情况下 bounce 音频。暴露这个 DAW 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive WordCraft from the agent: create documents, insert and style text, build tables and headers, track changes and comments, then save as DOCX or convert to PDF, ODT, RTF, Markdown and more. Exposes WordCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 WordCraft：新建文档、插入并排版文字、构建表格与页眉、跟踪修订与批注，并保存为 DOCX 或转换为 PDF、ODT、RTF、Markdown 等。暴露 WordCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Live DSH cost estimates from actual token usage & configurable pricing. / 基于真实 Token 用量与可配置价格的 DSH 开销监控插件。
description.zh: 按真实 Token 用量和自定义价格实时估算 DSH 开销，帮你随时掌握花费、避免超支。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的开发工作台：在对话旁浏览文件、阅读代码与文档、跳转定义、检查 Git 变更，并进行 Python、Go、JS／TS 断点调试。
description.zh: 在对话旁边直接看代码、查改动、断点调试，写代码不用来回切窗口。

description.en: MoA+ — Make agents work better together. Persistent Coordinator, reusable Workers and shared context for DeepSeek Harness. Unofficial rc.3 preview.
description.zh: 给项目配一个常驻协调者，自动管理多个 AI 助手分工协作、共享上下文，把活推进下去。

description.en: ACP server for DeepSeek Harness — bridges Zed and other IDEs to dsh agents
description.zh: 让 Zed 等 IDE 通过 ACP 协议直接连接 dsh 智能体，在编辑器里无缝使用 DeepSeek Harness 的编程能力。

description.en: Declarative DAG runtime for DSH tool plans with bounded parallel execution, read-only retries, per-step checkpoints, cancellation, and conservative crash recovery.
description.zh: DSH 工具计划的声明式 DAG 运行时，支持有界并行、只读重试、逐步落盘、取消及保守的崩溃恢复。

description.en: A live preview panel for the ArtCraft applications inside the DSH Web GUI: the agent step list, the current render, a filmstrip of earlier steps and a timeline for time-based crafts, fed by the craft plugins' renders.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 内的 ArtCraft 实时预览面板：智能体步骤流、当前渲染、历史步骤胶片条，以及时间轴类应用的时间轴，数据来自各 craft 插件生成的渲染图。

description.en: Compare Git/SVN versions across repositories and export Chinese Markdown release reports with optional approved model analysis.
description.zh: 比较多个 Git/SVN 项目的版本差异，导出中文 Markdown 发布报告，并可明确授权模型分析。

description.en: 借鉴 Luna-Chat 视觉语言的 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）换肤插件**，桌面端与 Web 端通用。

dsh-better-sidebar 的音频预览：可缩放波形 + 实时频谱 + 全曲频谱图，自带 HTTP Range 流式媒体路由 | Audio preview for dsh-better-sidebar: zoomable waveform, live spectrum, whole-file spectrogram, with its own Range-capable streaming media route
Let Deepseek Harness access the internet seamlessly.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 顺畅联网，替换官方搜索抓取工具，还能解析 PDF、Office 和 EPUB 文档。

description.en: DSH 本地记忆插件：自动记忆、遗忘曲线、关键词关联、可检索可编辑，数据留在本机。

Adds a red delete row to the sidebar session menu, plus a multi-select delete that confirms before running, and permanently removes the stored data behind a conversation — session directory and log, projection-cache record, workspace membership and pin.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单加入红色「删除对话」，并支持多选批量删除（二次确认），永久清除对话的磁盘数据——会话目录与日志、投影缓存记录、工作区归属与置顶。

description.en: Self-evolving pitfall immunity for coding agents: learn from failed-then-fixed tool calls, inject the lesson before the repeat. npm: dsh-immune-system. ZCode + DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让编程助手从踩过的坑里自动长记性，下次动手前先提醒你，避免重复犯错。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把远端机器当本地用 —— 文件树、终端、SFTP 断点续传、按方向镜像的编辑同步，以及 -L / -D / -R 三种转发。
description.zh: 把远端机器当本地用：文件树、终端、SFTP 断点续传、编辑同步和三种端口转发全都有。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多智能体群聊插件：独立会话、多模型角色、跨群 @ 协作、任务分工、成员记忆与审批。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里开多模型多角色群聊，让智能体分工协作、共享记忆、@ 互撩干活。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin that shows AnySearch references as cards, with the search query, source snippets and highlighted keywords in the right sidebar.一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，把 AnySearch 的搜索结果以卡片形式展示在右侧侧边栏中，包括搜索词、来源摘要和关键词高亮。
Playable world-model toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: look at frames, name the 3D / pixel / latent route, measure a run, and RSI the research loop.
description.zh: 世界模型研究工具箱，可查看帧、标记3D/像素/潜空间路径，对比预测与真值，并评估RSI技能和wm.yaml配置。

description.en: Structured agent reviews with independent panelists, disagreement resolution, and a separate critic.

DeepSeek Harness plugin with a settings page that downloads, enables and mounts MCP servers for work apps (Office, Blender, Unity, Figma, Photoshop, Chrome, Godot, Windows, Notion, Gmail, Cloudflare, Cloudflare Docs, GitHub, ComfyUI, FFmpeg, Obsidian), pl
description.zh: 把 Office、Notion、GitHub 等工作软件的 MCP 服务器统一挂载管理，随插件装卸，不污染配置。

description.en: Agnes AI 多模态融合插件：一个包同时提供「多模态配置」设置页（账号池，写入 $DSH_HOME/ag-multimodal.json）、generate_image 图片生成工具与 generate_video 视频生成工具，以及三者共用的一套会话内卡片 UI。融合自 dsh-agconfig + dsh-agimage + dsh-agvideo。1.1.0 起适配 DSH 0.2.1（官方删除 webRuntime 服务，信任校验改用 connection.requestRejection）。
Select a model and its reasoning effort in one drag with a two-dimensional grid.
description.zh: 使用二维网格，一次拖动同时选定模型与推理强度。

description.en: DSH 请求完成后在屏幕角落弹出提醒框，点击回到 DSH
IFC element/quantity inventory and CSV takeoff.
招标文件条款摘录核对（按出处与原文逐字核对摘录完整性，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查招标文件条款摘录表，核对每条摘录的来源、原文和提炼要求是否齐全。

description.en: 投标文件符合性预检（按招标文件逐条核对响应情况，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 按招标文件逐条核对投标响应台账，只提示漏项和差异，不替你下结论。

description.en: An Overview tab for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into progress, artifacts, and references.
「对话管理」全局面板页（浏览器半）：会话与统计两层 Tabs——会话视图给出全量会话（含已归档）的搜索、分页、归档 / 取消归档 / 导出 / 删除、导入为新会话与整理数据（孤儿回收 + 统计重算），统计视图给出全部对话的 token 用量。
Stateful PTY terminal sessions for LLM agents: screen snapshots, key input, wait conditions, and a terminal a human and an agent can share.
description.zh: 让智能体在真实终端里跑有状态会话，能截屏、发按键、等条件，人和 AI 还能共用一块屏幕协作。

description.en: Controllable convergence policy and agent loop replacement for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): runtime fingerprinting, finite recovery, file mutation guards, and soft tool requirements.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体换上可控的收敛策略和循环逻辑，管住文件改动、限制工具调用，让运行更稳更可预测。

description.en: Zero-config API usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): 24h token chart, per-day drill-down, per-provider/model colors, aggregated from local session logs.
description.zh: 零配置看板，一屏看清 24 小时 token 用量，按天、按模型拆分明细。

description.en: AI 对外说话前的一道门。聊天、评论、邮件、commit、PR、文档、注释都管：过了就发，没过就打回，附一句怎么改。
description.zh: AI 对外发言前的审核门，聊天、评论、邮件、commit、PR 都能先过一遍，不合格就打回并给出修改建议。

description.en: 🐋 大肥鱼 · 情绪耳朵 — Voice + emotion-aware companion for DeepSeek Harness. Listen, understand tone, and reply with empathy.
description.zh: 让大肥鱼听懂你的语音和情绪，用有温度的共情方式回复你，音频全程本地处理不上传。

description.en: 一瞥 / Glance：DSH Desktop 截图分析插件 —— 置顶悬浮球 + 框选任意区域 + 多模态流式分析
description.zh: 框选屏幕任意区域截图，AI 立刻流式分析，还能就着这张图继续追问。

description.en: HarnessMM: native DeepSeek Harness plugin implementing Executable Decision Graphs + Guarded Decision Reuse + Certified Callback Substitution, with a read-only session-view panel.
A long-term graph memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Neo4j.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个长期记忆库，把对话里的关键信息存进 Neo4j 图数据库，之后能按语义、实体或时间随时找回来。

description.en: Non-invasive runtime policy, PTC composite batch tools, soft convergence guidance, and A/B turn telemetry for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加运行时策略、批量工具和 A/B 轮次监控，帮智能体更省更快地收敛。

description.en: 由 Genca（缙嘉集团，上海缙嘉科技有限公司）VinkWork 团队开源的 DSH 插件：PSD 主图模板批量套 SKU、画布微调、整批导出。VinkWork 核心产品：VinkClaw.com。
description.zh: 把 PSD 主图模板批量套上不同 SKU，微调画布后整批导出，做电商主图省事多了。

description.en: DSH plugin: drag a region on screen, the crop drops straight into the composer
description.zh: 点一下截图按钮，拖框选中屏幕区域，图片直接落进输入框，省去截图保存再拖入的麻烦。

description.en: Codex-style session sidebar for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)    适用于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的 Codex 风格会话侧边栏：采用收件箱式活动视图（Activity View），分类管理运行中、待处理和未读会话；支持独立置顶空间、工作区内置顶、工作区树状结构、拖拽排序以及会话全文搜索。适用于 DSH 网页版和桌面版。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个 Codex 风格会话侧边栏，收件箱式管理运行中、待处理和未读会话，支持置顶、拖拽排序和全文搜索。

description.en: DSH plugin: fishbone session timeline with handoff lineage and manual links
description.zh: 在侧边栏把工作区所有会话画成鱼骨时间线，handoff 血缘和手动衔接一目了然，双击直达历史会话。

description.en: 陪伴型机器人的情感记忆层：事件编码、情绪加权遗忘、联想召回、关系与技能，还会承认自己记不清｜An emotion-weighted memory layer for long-running companion bots.
DSH whiteboard plugin: right-sidebar canvas with native selection references and Host-enforced AI tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏随手画图，把选区当引用塞进对话，让 AI 直接读改画板。

description.en: Local hardware monitor for DSH: a sidebar dashboard, a composer-dock CPU/memory/GPU widget, and a hardware_monitor_status tool backed by a local Python service installed separately from the repository root with install-dsh.ps1 (Windows, Python 3.10); installing only the DSH plugin leaves the panel and tool offline.
description.zh: DSH 本机硬件监控插件：侧边栏完整面板、输入框下方的 CPU/内存/GPU 挂件，以及 hardware_monitor_status 工具。数据来自另装的本地 Python 服务：需在仓库根用 install-dsh.ps1 安装（Windows、Python 3.10）；只装 DSH 插件时面板与工具均不可用。

description.en: Evidence-driven memory, orchestration, benchmarks, and release workflows for DeepSeek Harness.

One Settings page for OpenCode Go: an account pool that rotates A-to-B when a key runs out or stops authenticating, per-account 5-hour/weekly/monthly allowance, per-model spend with remaining quota, capability tags (image, video, text-only, tools, reasoning), a live OpenCode-vs-official-API cost comparison, and 10 UI languages.
description.zh: 一个设置页管完 OpenCode Go：账户池在密钥额度耗尽或鉴权失败时自动 A→B 轮替，按账户显示 5 小时/本周/本月额度，按模型显示用量与剩余额度并标出能力（图像、视频、纯文本、工具调用、推理），另有「走 OpenCode 还是官方直连更划算」的实时换算与 10 种界面语言。

description.en: Adds a "Handoff session" item to the session context menu: pick an older session, choose how the new one should read it, and a fresh session is created with the handoff instruction pre-filled in its composer while the old session stays untouched. Three read modes — the AI decides what to read, a six-part summary written into a .md file, or just the last 20 turns. The second tab turns those .md files into a cleanup list grouped by workspace, deletable once the receiving session has run 3 turns or the handoff is 7 days old. All file, record and turn-count operations run in the host process; the browser half only renders and requests. Requires Windows and the DSH desktop app (it uses Electron shell.openPath and explorer.exe/cmd.exe).
description.zh: 在会话右键菜单加「移交会话」：选一个老会话、挑新会话用哪种模式怎么读，新开一个上下文干净的会话，交接指令已预填进输入框；老会话全程不动。三种读取方式——AI 自行判断读多少、让 AI 先写成六段摘要落到 .md、或只读最近 20 轮。第二个标签把那批 .md 变成按工作区分组的清理清单，接手会话跑满 3 轮或移交满 7 天即可逐条删除。删文件、写记录、数轮数全部在主进程完成，界面只负责画和发请求。需要 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面版（依赖 Electron shell.openPath 与 explorer.exe / cmd.exe）。

description.en: Shows the official COT machine translation inside dsh-better-display's reading view, with a per-card original/translated toggle on better-display 0.3.12 and later.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-display 的阅读页显示官方「思考过程机器翻译」译文，并在 better-display 0.3.12 及以上提供按卡片切换原文/译文。

description.en: An always-on working style for DSH agents, packaged as an agent preset: restate the task, read before editing, verify each change with a real command, keep context lean. Ships 29 skills (plan loops, review loops, TDD, unsticking, PR watching) plus a turn guard that pushes back when a turn edits files without a successful check afterwards, and pushes back harder on a second miss.
description.zh: 以 agent preset 形式提供的 DSH 常驻工作方式：复述任务、改前先读、每步用真实命令验证、控制上下文体积。内含 29 个技能（计划循环、评审循环、TDD、卡住换思路、PR 跟踪），以及一个回合守卫：当本轮改了文件却没有在之后跑成任何检查时出言打回，第二次再犯时措辞更硬。

description.en: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.
description.zh: 会话列旁的可折叠栏：把对话按工作区与主题组织成树，就地打开真实会话，并通过 9 个模型工具让助手读写这棵树。

description.en: Browse and continue DeepSeek web conversations in DSH, or import them with attachments into a workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内浏览和继续 DeepSeek 网页会话，或将历史与附件导入工作区。

description.en: Hatsune Miku theme for DSH with light and dark appearance, character artwork, and phone navigation. Requires the Ekko skin manager.
description.zh: 初音未来主题，提供浅深色外观、人物装饰与手机导航，需搭配 Ekko 皮肤管理器。

description.en: One-off btw side questions that inherit the current DSH session, with selectable context ranges and an optional compressed summary you review before sending it into the main session.
description.zh: 在当前 DSH 会话里发起一次性 btw 旁问，可选上下文范围；旁问默认不写入会话，可把压缩摘要预览确认后送入主会话。

description.en: Sidebar file explorer for DeepSeek Harness: a lazy workspace tree with in-panel preview for text, Markdown and images, and an action that hands a file to the system default app.
description.zh: 在侧栏里浏览工作区：懒加载文件树，面板内预览文本 / Markdown / 图片，并可交给系统默认程序打开。

description.en: Fusion 360 for DSH: bridges the MCP server Fusion ships (read, execute, update, electronics) with every upstream schema kept byte-for-byte while the always-on tool surface drops 70 percent, adds an editable endpoint under Settings, and wraps a local hf.py modelling loop as nine hf_* tools (needs Python 3.10+ and a fusion-harness workspace).
description.zh: 把 Fusion 360 接进 DSH：桥接 Fusion 自带的 MCP 服务（读取、执行、更新、电子设计），上游 schema 逐字节保留而常驻工具面减少 70%，设置页可改端点，并把本地 hf.py 建模闭环包成九个 hf_* 工具（需要 Python 3.10+ 与 fusion-harness 工作区）。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin for previewing 3D models, supporting FBX, OBJ, glTF/GLB, and STL files · DSH 3D 查看器
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接预览 FBX、OBJ、glTF/GLB、STL 等 3D 模型，不用切换软件就能看效果

description.en: Second brain for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown memory + git sync, reviewed card capture, cloud/local split.
description.zh: 用 Markdown 文件当记忆库、git 做同步，让 DSH 和网页版聊天记录互通，随时存取你的第二大脑。

description.en: AI brainstorming canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在画布上跟 AI 一起头脑风暴，把想法随手铺开、连线整理，激发创意。

description.en: 把 caveman 的输出风格技能整套移植成 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）原生插件：caveman/ultracave/megacave 三档语气、commit、review、compress（本地压缩+闸门）与 6 个 native 工作流纪律技能。技术事实、代码、命令与报错原样保留。
description.zh: 把 caveman 的省话风格搬进 DSH，三档语气加代码审查、提交、压缩，少说废话多留事实。

description.en: Independent chat sessions for DeepSeek Harness, with per-room working directories and native sidebar integration.
description.zh: 给日常问答和临时任务开独立对话，每个对话有自己的工作目录，侧栏直接管理。

description.en: DSH plugin: a left-sidebar gallery of every file the assistant generated across all conversations
DeepSeek Harness plugin: skills catalog with preview, editor, versions, archive (trash) and A/B comparison
description.zh: 在侧边栏管理 AI 技能：预览、编辑、版本管理、回收站和 A/B 对比，还能让 AI 帮你改进。

description.en: DSH 右栏程序管理控制台 · start, stop, package, deploy over SSH and restart containers for workspace services.
DeepSeek Harness 插件：在 diffprobe 之上做差分 fuzz 与逻辑测试（抽值 → 计划 → 执行 → 判定），默认只读。
description.zh: 在 diffprobe 上做差分 fuzz 和逻辑测试，自动抽值、计划、执行、判定，默认只读，适合授权渗透测试。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 一键分组提交插件：Angular 规范分组、当前模型生成 message、插件直接执行 git 提交
description.zh: 按 Angular 规范自动分组改动，用当前模型生成提交信息并直接执行 git 提交，省去手写 commit 的麻烦。

description.en: Use GitHub CLI in DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 通过已认证的 gh CLI 读取和审查 GitHub 仓库，省去匿名 API 的调用限制。

description.en: DSH Go 原生插件：自动找到手机上的 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接 · Native dsh-go plugin: finds the phone's ADB TCP port and keeps adb connected
description.zh: 自动找到手机 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接，在 DSH 的 bash 里直接 adb shell 用。

description.en: 古法编程 · AI 辅助 — DeepSeek Harness 的 VS Code 风格 IDE 模式插件（Monaco 编辑器 / Git / SSH / PTY 终端 / 官方会话停靠右侧）
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一键切到 VS Code 风格 IDE，左边写代码，右边就是当前会话，改文件跑终端全看得见。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：热点采集、去重、确定性打分与草稿落地，支持侧边栏入口与控制面板
description.zh: 自动采集热点、去重并打分，一键生成 VitePress 博客草稿，省去手动整理选题的麻烦。

description.en: Inline Visuals · 14 replayable visual kinds for DeepSeek Harness — charts, tables, timelines, gantt, heatmaps, flows and KPI tiles.
description.zh: 让 AI 在对话里直接画图表、表格、时间线、甘特图、热力图等 14 种可视化，还能回放查看。

description.en: Канбан-доска для DeepSeek Harness: отдельная доска у каждого проекта, задачи с черновиками и статусом «Можно делать», карточки с агентами, субагентами и фоновыми job, детали задачи в правой панели приложения и инструменты для агента.

把 Matt Pocock 技能套件编成六阶段带前置条件的开发工作流：拷问、规范、任务、实现、评审、收尾。含输入框工具行的阶段胶囊与决策卡片。A six-stage gated development workflow preset for DSH: grill, spec, tickets, implement, review, wrap-up. Adds a stage chip in the composer and decision cards. Built on the Matt Pocock skill suite.
description.zh: 把 Matt Pocock 技能套件串成六阶段带前置条件的开发流程，从拷问到收尾一步步推进。

description.en: Conversation rewind for DeepSeek Harness: rewind the conversation to any earlier user message in one click, in the same window. No new branch, no window switch, with optional workspace-file restore — the full Claude Code /rewind semantics.
description.zh: 一键把对话回退到之前任意一条用户消息，同窗口完成还能顺带还原工作区文件，改错重来不用开新分支。

description.en: Live Office tools for DeepSeek Harness: read the document the user has open in Word/Excel/PowerPoint, screenshot the app window, and edit it in place through COM. 中文说明见 README.zh.md
description.zh: 直接读取、截图并就地编辑你正开着的 Word、Excel、PPT 文档，不用来回切换。

description.en: 按钮与菜单由底座 `dsh-open-in-app-base` 统一渲染，本插件只负责「目标软件」这一半：注册一条目标记录，并在自己的宿主半边实现「是否可用」与「怎么打开」。不 fork、不修改宿主，也不依赖原生 open-in-app 的应用目录——插件自带一个本机路由，直接向 CodeBuddy CN 的 CLI 入口传递目录参数。
description.zh: 一键用本机 CodeBuddy CN 打开当前会话的工作区目录，右键菜单和按钮都能用。

description.en: Pixel, reactive, retrospective, static, and native themes for the DSH Web GUI, with animated pixel backgrounds, pointer halos, pixel geometry, and canvas/composer materials.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面换上一套像素风外观，带动态像素背景和指针光晕，让界面更有复古游戏感。

description.en: Host plugin that adds the /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct command and the dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct tool to any session for a full book walkthrough plus one deep insight.
description.zh: Host 插件：任意会话可用 /dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 命令与 dsh-plugin-book-deconstruct 工具，输入书名与作者后讲透全书并给出一段深度思想。

description.en: Database structure for DeepSeek Harness — indexes a database catalog into a local store so the agent knows every table and column before it writes a query, then answers with one tool call
description.zh: 把数据库表结构索引到本地，让 AI 写 SQL 前就摸清每张表和字段，一次调用直接出结果。

description.en: Discover and install community DSH bundles: newbie essentials, recommendations, categories, npm/GitHub search.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏发现、推荐并一键安装社区插件，新手也能快速上手。

description.en: Codex-style single-panel model and effort picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer
description.zh: 把输入框的模型选择换成单层面板，选模型、拖思考强度一屏搞定，不用再点两级菜单。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：Python 快捷执行工具，源码经 stdin 直灌 `python -X utf8 -u -`，一步返回结果，全链路 UTF-8，支持后台作业与沙箱提权。
description.zh: 一句话让 AI 直接跑 Python 代码，结果秒回，还支持后台任务和沙箱提权。

description.en: 每天看一眼今天是什么日子：日、月、火、水、木、金、土，顺手给点安排灵感，不算吉凶。
description.zh: 敲一句 /qiyao 就知道今天是七曜里的哪一天、有什么传统象征，还能顺手给你点安排灵感，不算吉凶。

description.en: WorkBuddy daily auto check-in and credit claiming for DeepSeek Harness. Three agent tools (status / claim / login), bundled Chrome-driven engine, no tokens required.
DSH 插件：把准备好的提示词注入系统提示词，可随时回退（Prompt injection with rollback for DeepSeek Harness）
description.zh: 给 DSH 注入自定义系统提示词，对所有会话生效，还能随时回退到原样，改错了也不怕。

description.en: Floating quota ring in the DSH Web UI: DeepSeek balance + today's spend + peak/off-peak bar, GPT (Codex) 5h/weekly windows, Gemini's three Antigravity pools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面挂个悬浮额度环，一眼看清 DeepSeek 余额和今日花费、GPT 与 Gemini 各窗口用量。

description.en: SSH workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: multi-host connections, remote workspaces, terminal, port forwarding.
description.zh: 把 DSH 连上任意多台 SSH 机器，远程文件夹直接当工作区用，还能开终端、做端口转发。

description.en: Lets the conversation AI maintain a plain-language functional requirements checklist in a dedicated session view. A non-official rebuild of Songran241/dsh-req-workbench that keeps the upstream package name; do not install it alongside the upstream original.
description.zh: 让对话中的 AI 在会话需求页整理、合并和更新通俗的功能清单。基于 Songran241/dsh-req-workbench 的非官方重构版，沿用上游包名，不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: dsh-purge 的野生补丁：给破甲加一道高危操作确认闸门（human-in-the-loop），不改宿主、不撤销破甲。
description.zh: 给破甲加一道高危操作确认闸门，危险动作先问你一句再执行，不改宿主也不撤销破甲。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: agent status in the macOS menu bar (SwiftBar) — pending approvals, running tasks, finished tasks, plus system notifications.
description.zh: 在 macOS 菜单栏实时显示 DSH 智能体状态，待审批、运行中、已完成一目了然，还会发系统通知。

description.en: Strawberry research tools for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用自然语言查草莓研究文献、解析基因、看多组学数据，还能下载校验过的 FASTA 序列。

description.en: One-shot ZCode CLI delegation provider for DeepSeek Harness (subagent_zcode tool)
description.zh: 把一次性任务交给本机 ZCode CLI 执行，让 DSH 多一个可调用的子智能体。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 风格会话摘要面板：输出文件、附件与网页来源
description.zh: 把会话里交付的文件、附件和网页来源汇总成一张摘要卡片，方便一眼看清产出和出处。

description.en: Synapsis 析域 —— 把讲义铺成一张能走进去的概念图（DSH Web UI 面板插件）
description.zh: 把讲义概念铺成能层层深入的概念地图，每张卡片带定义、例子和易错点，边看边学。

description.en: A polished theme studio for DeepSeek Harness: 25 presets, fonts, wallpapers, brand and favicon.
description.zh: 给 DSH 客户端一键换装：25 套配色、字体、壁纸和玻璃质感随便调，改完立刻生效。

description.en: DSH 插件：per-session 追问澄清开关 + 会话复盘写入长期记忆。分类：对话增强 / 记忆。
description.zh: 需求含糊时先追问清楚再动手，还能把本轮复盘整理好，按你同意写入长期记忆。

description.en: 让 agent 的每一步都看得见 · 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话的任务清单变成输入框上方一条常驻进度条
description.zh: 把会话任务清单变成输入框上方的常驻进度条，agent 每一步进展都一目了然。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 待办插件：自动记录每条待办的创建与完成时间，用表格 / 看板 / 甘特图 / 日历四视图呈现真实耗时；支持分类、优先级、类型、@工作区文件与 todo_time_log 智能体工具。
description.zh: 自动记录待办创建和完成时间，用表格、看板、甘特图、日历四种视图看清真实耗时。

description.en: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里已登录的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，修复上游 WAF 11128 对系统提示词的拦截（基于 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里已登录的模型接进 DSH，还顺手修好了上游 WAF 拦截系统提示词的问题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 的整页浏览器面板，支持多标签、地址栏、右键菜单、主页常用网址与 IndexedDB 浏览历史；只给人用，不向 AI 注册任何工具。 A full-page browser panel for DeepSeek Harness Desktop with tabs, an address bar, a context menu, a pinned homepage and IndexedDB history. Human-only: registers no AI-facing tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加个整页浏览器，多标签、地址栏、右键菜单和浏览历史都齐了，只给人用不碰 AI。

description.en: Password gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that also removes the 403 a reverse proxy causes, with revocable sessions, an admin page and zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web UI 加密码登录，同时修掉反向代理导致的 403，带可吊销会话、管理页和零依赖。

description.en: WSL workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: one persistent in-distro agent instead of 9P polling. Sidebar W entry, in-distro terminal, WSL-native grep/glob, wsl-<mode> preset variants.
description.zh: 在 WSL 里跑一个常驻的 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，侧边栏一键进入，终端和搜索都用 WSL 原生，比 9P 轮询快得多。

description.en: Official remote cloud relay plugin for DSHost (dshost.me): securely access your dsh Web UI from anywhere
description.zh: 官方云端中继插件，让你随时随地安全访问自己的 dsh Web 界面。

description.en: 一个让常驻 agent 拥有连续记忆和真实生活线的 DSH 插件
description.zh: 给常驻 agent 装上连续记忆和真实生活线，让它有日子、有节律地陪着你。

description.en: 鲸鱼钱包：给 DSH 桌宠 whale-girl 加上余额 / 每步花费 / 峰谷提示
description.zh: 给桌宠鲸鱼娘加上余额、每步花费和峰谷提示，点开菜单就能随时看钱花在哪。

description.en: Requirement-to-delivery workbench: paste or upload a requirement, and a plan-dispatch-verify loop delivers it with child agents and test evidence.
description.zh: 需求驱动交付工作台：粘贴或上传需求后，规划-派发-验证闭环驱动子 agent 交付，并以测试证据判定完成。

description.en: 合同条款立场核对：依据《中华人民共和国民法典》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查合同条款立场台账，确保条款文本、立场和风险等级都记录规范、有据可查。

description.en: 环评文件核对：依据《环境影响评价技术导则》系列《环境影响评价技术导则 总纲》（各导则现行版本号本次未逐一核实）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 核对环评导则适用性表，检查要素与导则编号是否可追溯、规范。

description.en: 作文评分表核对：依据《普通高中语文课程标准》《普通高等学校招生全国统一考试评卷工作规定》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查作文量表评分表的算术和证据，核对每项标准、等级描述与分数上限是否对得上。

description.en: Output gallery in the DSH sidebar, built to fix DSH reporting produced files only after a task ends: it watches your on-disk output folders and shows files as they appear, so you can verify and intervene mid-task instead of after. Auto-refreshing image thumbnails with zoom and pan, documents, code, data, archives and links that open in DSH native preview, per-conversation filtering, and multi-folder support for sessions whose cwd is outside the default output folder. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧栏变成产出目录的实时画廊，专门解决 DSH「只在任务结束时才列出产出文件、过程不可见」的问题：直接盯磁盘产出目录，文件一生成就能看到，方便在任务进行中校验与纠正。图片缩略图自动刷新、支持缩放拖动；文档、代码、数据、压缩包与链接点击即调用 DSH 原生侧栏预览；支持按「本对话产出」筛选；支持多扫描目录，兼容工作目录不在默认产出目录下的会话。零依赖。

description.en: An IDE inside DeepSeek Harness with a file tree, multi-tab editor, AI assistant with model picker and API-key setup, Git panel, PTY terminal, and Python/TypeScript LSP.
description.zh: 内置在 DeepSeek Harness 里的 IDE：文件树、多标签编辑器、AI 助手（模型选择/API Key）、Git 面板、PTY 终端和 Python/TypeScript LSP。

description.en: Interactive physics lab in the DSH sidebar — 24 parameter-driven animations (mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics) grouped by grade, each with a knowledge-point lesson whose steps follow the animation, a quiz with answer checking, and a draggable 3D view for four field models. Pure client side: analytic solutions computed locally, no LLM calls, no network, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的高中物理动态仿真实验室：24 个可调参数的互动模型（力学 / 电磁 / 光学 / 热学），按高一高二高三分组；每个模型配知识点讲解与跟随动画的分步解说、出题判分，其中 4 个电磁学模型支持拖动旋转的 3D 视角。纯客户端，解析式本地计算，不调模型、不联网、不上报数据。

description.en: PPAP 提交资料核对：依据《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 自动核对 PPAP 提交要素清单，检查客户要求的要素是否有提交记录，帮你快速发现漏交项。

description.en: Using Ai tools to finish my daily work report
description.zh: 把本机 AI 编程和聊天记录按项目归好类，自动整理成日报周报，数据不出本地。

description.en: Multi-agent agent team of employee AI subagents for DeepSeek Harness — dsh-company: employee management, CEO bidding, n8n workflow orchestration, drag and drop canvas. DeepSeek Harness plugin with seven built-in roles (project director, product manager, tech lead, engineer, data analyst, QA, reviewer), each with its own persona, model and tool whitelist. Broadcast a mission and the employees bid for it themselves — the first line of their answer must be 【accept】 or 【decline】 — so accepted work runs in parallel instead of down a pipeline. The workflow canvas wires employee nodes with the start node, references each upstream result with {{input}}, and runs the graph in topological layers: parallel across employees, serial per employee, downstream skipped when upstream fails. Ships a web panel for the employee management tab, the mission board and each employee's transcript, the /dsh-company slash command, a live mirror into the built-in agent-team panel, deletable missions, and a private memory directory per employee.
description.zh: dsh-company：多智能体 AI 团队、子智能体公司。员工管理、CEO 认单派活、n8n 式工作流编排：拖拽员工节点到画布、连线、并行执行。DeepSeek Harness 插件，七个内置角色（项目总监、产品经理、技术总监、工程师、数据分析师、测试工程师、审核员），每人各有人设、模型与工具白名单。任务广播下去，员工自己决定接不接——回复第一行必须是【接单】或【不接】——接单的人并行开工，而不是走流水线。工作流画布用开始节点串起员工节点，用 {{input}} 引用上游产出，图按拓扑分层执行：跨员工并行、同员工串行、上游失败下游自动跳过。附员工管理、任务板与员工对话详情的网页面板，/dsh-company 斜杠命令，与内置 agent-team 面板的实时联动，可删除的任务，以及每员工独立的记忆目录。

description.en: One MCP tool instead of every schema you own — a lazy capability broker that cuts resident tool context by a measured 94.4%. Search, inspect, enable and call MCP servers and skills on demand.
description.zh: 把一堆 MCP 工具压成一个入口，按需搜索、启用和调用，工具上下文直降 94.4%。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自动检测与更新器：Windows 桌面小工具 + DSH 网页版插件（会话标题栏「检测 / 回滚 / 版本」）
description.zh: 自动检测并更新 DeepSeek Harness，桌面小工具和网页插件都能用，还能一键回滚版本。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）服务面板插件：按会话查看由哪个 Agent 会话启动了哪些服务，三态健康点 + HTTP 码、启动时间与运行时长、礼貌停止、实时日志带、原地重启并重放原命令行。基于上游 dsh-process-board 的补丁分叉（Windows）：修好重启后日志失效、扫描器误合并同名启动器、面板抢走输入框焦点。A docked DSH service panel plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按会话查看谁启动了哪些服务，带健康探测、实时日志、礼貌停止和原地重启。

description.en: LLM 成本统计插件（DeepSeek Harness）：按真实 token 用量折算费用，每次调用计费 + 会话汇总 + 使用统计页（UI 全面对齐 CC Switch 风格）· CC-Switch-style usage dashboard, per-call cost & session summary
description.zh: 帮你盯住每次模型调用的 token 花费，按真实用量算钱，还能看会话汇总和统计页。

description.en: A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent's instructions.
DSH agent-fleet hygiene audit plugin: credential-file permissions, embedded git-remote credentials (masked), provider token literals. Read-only, zero-dependency, deterministic.
A lightweight, DSH-native code editor with intelligent coding assistance, minimizing reliance on external IDEs.
description.zh: 轻量化 DSH 原生代码编辑器，集成智能编程辅助能力，减少对外部 IDE 的依赖。

description.en: A desktop pet for DSH: a blue whale girl with 104 animations and built-in voice. It is standalone, but its pet runtime is a rework of dsh-dafeiyu — disable the upstream dsh-dafeiyu before installing, or both will run and fight over the control port. Windows x64 only, and the first launch downloads about 580 MB of assets.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：蓝色鲸鱼娘，自带 104 个动作与内置语音。插件独立，但桌宠运行时基于 dsh-dafeiyu 改造——安装前需先禁用上游 dsh-dafeiyu，否则两只同开会抢控制口；仅支持 Windows x64，首次启动需下载约 580MB 素材。

description.en: Shortcut buttons in the composer row that send preset text into the current conversation in one click. Button label, size, opacity, shape and payload are editable in place, and the whole group moves left or right of the context meter by right-click dragging, persisted in localStorage. The group takes only the width it needs, so the context meter and the usage area stay clickable.
description.zh: 在输入框一行放一组快捷按钮，点一下把预设文字发进当前对话。每个按钮的名称、大小、透明度、形状与发送内容都可就地编辑；右键拖动整组可在上下文进度左右换位，选择保存在本地。按钮组只占自身宽度，不会挤压上下文进度与用量区域。

description.en: Local-first resume warehouse for DeepSeek Harness: package your work into reusable bullets, import an existing resume into a template, analyse a job description (including the school-tier preference it implies), assemble a tailored Chinese or English resume and export a PDF named position-name-school. The whole app ships inside the npm package — server/, web/, skills/, scripts/, requirements.txt, no git clone needed — and one tool starts, stops and health-checks it; the first start installs the dependencies into app/.venv. Needs Python 3.10+ and macOS or Linux (bash). Nothing leaves the machine except the LLM calls you confirm.
description.zh: 本地优先的简历仓库：把经历打包成可复用的表述、把现有简历拆成模板、分析岗位 JD（含其隐含的院校层次偏好）、组装中英双语定制简历并导出「岗位-姓名-学校」命名的 PDF。应用本体随 npm 包发布（server/、web/、skills/、scripts/、requirements.txt，无需 clone 仓库），自带工具负责启动/停止并读取健康状态，首次启动会把依赖装进 app/.venv；需要 Python 3.10+ 与 macOS / Linux（bash）。除你确认过的 LLM 调用外数据不出本机。

description.en: Give your agent an external emotion state machine: several axes (0-100) that drift over time and move when you speak to it. Each turn the plugin injects which band you are in plus which tags you may use. The numbers belong to the plugin: the model reads them from the injected prompt and can change them only through the plugin's own emotion tools, never by asserting a mood.
description.zh: 把 AI 的情绪搬到模型外面：几条情绪轴各 0-100，按你说的话加减、随时间自己漂移，每轮把「现在处在哪一档 + 可用标签」注入系统提示。数值由插件维护：模型从注入的提示里读到当前值，只能通过插件自带的情绪工具调整，不能凭一句自报心情改数。默认空配置，一个轴都不替你定。

description.en: Local media toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: converts files between 27 video, audio and image formats, trims clips, extracts audio or video tracks without re-encoding, exports embedded subtitles to .srt, compresses images with a before/after preview, reads and rewrites metadata, and encodes or decodes Base64 — all through the ffmpeg already installed on the machine, so files never leave it. The same engine is registered as a media_toolbox tool agents can call.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地多媒体工具箱：27 种视频/音频/图片格式互转、裁剪、不重编码地剥离音轨或画面、导出内嵌字幕为 .srt、带前后对比预览的图片压缩、元数据查看与改写、Base64 编解码——全部走本机已装的 ffmpeg，文件不出本机；同一引擎也注册为 agent 可调用的 media_toolbox 工具。

description.en: Speaks the estimated spend of each turn aloud with an Alipay-style voice clip or a bundled meme voice; amounts come from dsh-cost-meter when installed, otherwise from per-model token prices. All audio is bundled, so nothing is fetched at runtime.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束用支付宝音效播报本轮花费估算（也可换成内置的大白饭梗音色）；金额优先取 dsh-cost-meter，未安装时按模型单价估算；音频全部内置、运行时不联网。

description.en: Watches download commands (git clone, package-manager installs, curl) and, when one overruns its budget, aborts it and writes a switch-source advisory into the tool result, so the agent retries from another mirror instead of waiting on a dead one. Timeouts are set per kind of work, and acting versus only reporting is switched per scene. A supervisor indicator reacts while something is stalled.
description.zh: 盯着下载类命令（git clone、包管理器安装、curl），超出预算就中止，并把一句换源建议写进工具结果，让智能体换个镜像重试而不是对着死源干等。超时按工作类型分别设置，「动手换源」与「只提示」按场景独立开关；另有一个只在卡顿时反应的监督员指示器。

description.en: DSH plugin: three MCP tool servers for DingTalk (via the dws CLI), Feishu (via lark-cli) and Feishu Project (via the official @lark-project/mcp), reusing the accounts dws and lark-cli are already logged in with, plus a Feishu Project MCP user token you paste in the panel; once the three connectors are connected, the default set is 140 tools (47 DingTalk, 45 Feishu, 48 Feishu Project) under the mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__ prefixes. A sidebar panel adds a connector wall with one-click connect (installs the CLI and walks through device-code login, or takes the Feishu Project token), custom MCP connections pasted as mcpServers JSON, enable/disable per connection, the write-tool switch, and a searchable catalog of the 1098 dws and 246 lark-cli commands.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把钉钉（走 dws CLI）、飞书（走 lark-cli）和飞书项目（走官方 @lark-project/mcp）做成三个 MCP 工具服务器，钉钉与飞书复用这两个 CLI 已登录的账号，飞书项目需在面板里填入 MCP 用户令牌；三个连接器都连好后默认注册 140 个工具（钉钉 47、飞书 45、飞书项目 48），前缀分别是 mcp__dingtalk__ / mcp__feishu__ / mcp__meego__。侧边栏面板提供连接器墙（一键连接：装 CLI 并走设备码登录，或填飞书项目令牌）、粘贴 mcpServers JSON 添加自定义 MCP、逐条启停、写工具开关，以及可搜索的 1098 条 dws 与 246 条 lark-cli 命令目录。

description.en: Cache-first context compaction with an optional adaptive economic policy, observation-only by default, without cache-hit or cost-saving guarantees.
description.zh: 缓存优先的上下文压缩，提供可选的自适应经济策略，默认仅观察，不保证缓存命中或费用节省。

description.en: Quiet Carl the hedgehog easter eggs after a finished turn, plus local water, meal and rest reminders. Fully local scheduling with no model calls and no chat messages.
description.zh: 任务结束后偶尔让卡尔从屏幕边缘探头，并提醒喝水、吃饭、休息；完全本地调度，不发送聊天消息、不调用模型。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-tree snapshots, click by control name, delivery verdicts, and repeatable task files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面操控：读无障碍树、按控件名点击、动作投递判定，以及可重复执行的任务文件。

description.en: QUASAR — a space-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness: an ink black hole in the sidebar and a live accretion disk rendered behind the app, with frosted-glass panels. Motion is canvas-driven and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
description.zh: QUASAR — DeepSeek Harness 的太空主题皮肤：侧栏里一颗墨色黑洞，应用背后实时渲染吸积盘，配合磨砂玻璃面板。动效由 canvas 驱动，尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。

description.en: Adds an Artifact Space entry to the DSH sidebar that lists the final effective artifacts of each session, grouped by workspace and session, with an editor-style preview, image previews, search across workspaces and sessions, favorites, and provenance for every file.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏新增「产物空间」入口，按工作区与会话分组列出每个会话的最终有效产物，支持编辑器风格预览、图片预览、跨工作区与会话搜索、收藏夹与每个文件的来源追溯。

description.en: Injects your own text into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt as real system sections from a sidebar editor: each section lands after the persona, after the tool docs, or at the very end of the prompt, can be switched on or off, and can resolve {{variables}}; a preview runs the host's own assemble and render pass so you see the exact prompt the next request will send, with empty, duplicate, unknown-variable and oversize sections flagged.
description.zh: 把你的文字作为真正的 system 段落注入 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词：侧栏编辑器里为每段选择落点（人格之后、工具说明之后，或提示词最末尾），逐段启停，可解析 {{变量}}；预览调用宿主真实的 assemble 与 render，看清下一个请求实际发出的提示词，并标出空段、重复行、未知变量与超长段落。

description.en: Park whole tool packs out of the session's tool surface and mount them back with one command. Cuts the tool table from 99,789 to 48,144 characters (51.8%) without uninstalling plugins or restarting. Reversible per group, per agent.
description.zh: 把整包工具从会话的工具面上摘掉，要用时一条命令挂回来。工具表从 99,789 字符降到 48,144（51.8%），不用卸载插件、不用重启，按组可逆、按 agent 独立。

description.en: Page-level startup splash: a Penrose triangle light sweep over a living isometric diamond ocean, where the frame itself is the progress gauge, paced by the intro but capped by real DSH boot milestones. Any bare key skips it, ten palettes come from Monument Valley and Geometric Islands, and when the intro ends the triangle stays on as a small mark beside the composer that reflects what the agent is doing.
description.zh: 页面级启动开屏：彭罗斯三角在等距菱格海面上旋转受光，取景框本身就是进度计，按开屏节奏平滑推进、以真实 DSH 启动完成度为上限；按任意键跳过，主题坞提供 Monument Valley / Geometric Islands 十套色板。开屏结束后三角留在输入框旁，作为一枚反映当前工作状态的小标记。

description.en: Counts the assistant rounds that call tools without writing anything to the user, then inserts a short progress reminder as a visible user message at the next model-request boundary, so a long silent tool loop reports what it has done before continuing. A Settings page adjusts the silence threshold (default 10), the reminder wording, the language (en / zh-CN / zh-TW), whether the reminder repeats every further threshold of silent rounds, whether subagent sessions are counted, and whether Agent Teams nudges the lead only or every member.
description.zh: 统计「只调用工具、没有向用户输出文字」的助手轮数，在下一次模型请求的边界把一条简短的过程汇报提醒作为可见的用户消息插入，让长时间沉默的工具循环先汇报已完成的工作再继续。设置页可调整沉默阈值（默认 10）、提醒文案、文案语言（en / zh-CN / zh-TW）、是否每再积累一个阈值就再次提醒、是否统计子代理会话，以及启用智能体团队时只提醒 Lead 还是所有成员。

description.en: Cooking recipes in DSH: a full panel in the Web GUI plus four recipe_* tools for the agent. 373 home-cooking recipes — mostly Chinese, with Western, Japanese and Korean dishes mixed in — bundled with 347 dish photos and three kitchen-tip illustrations; the dataset is derived from the open-source HowToCook project (Unlicense) and was cleaned, unit-repaired and re-typeset for this plugin. Browse by dish, category or the ingredients you already have, get a daily pick, keep favourites and cooked marks, and read kitchen tips. Everything ships inside the plugin: offline, no hotlinking, no telemetry.
description.zh: 菜谱面板 + 4 个 recipe_* 工具：373 道家常菜谱（以中式为主，兼收西式与日韩菜式），随包附带 347 张菜品图与 3 张厨房技巧插图，数据取自开源项目 HowToCook（Unlicense）并经清洗、单位修正与重排。按菜名、分类或手头食材找菜，每日推荐、收藏与「做过」标记、厨房技巧；数据随插件分发，离线可用，不热链、无遥测。

description.en: Offline civil-service exam study panel integrating 15 upstream open-source question banks with SRS wrong-book, mock exams, essay grading, interactive knowledge graph and whitebox observability. The npm package ships no question-bank data: after install, the required set (~363 MB) is cloned from the question-bank manager (all 15 upstream repos are about 2.2 GB).
description.zh: 离线公务员备考学习面板，整合 15 个上游开源题库，提供 SRS 错题本、整卷模考、申论离线评改、可交互知识图谱与白盒可观测。npm 包不含题库数据：安装后需在题库管理里克隆必选包（约 363 MB，15 个上游仓库全量约 2.2 GB）。

description.en: Computer-aided translation, inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中完成计算机辅助翻译。

description.en: SSH-backed remote directories and linked local⇄remote workspaces: read-only remote browsing, an editable linked workbench, bidirectional SFTP transfer, mirroring and a linked_workspace tool. Sidebar pages require the dsh-better-sidebar plugin (v0.24+); without it only the Settings pages load.
description.zh: 把 SSH 连接变成 DSH 远程目录与本地⇄远端联动工作区：远程目录只读浏览，联动工作区可编辑、双向传输、镜像同步，并提供 linked_workspace 工具。侧栏页面需配合 dsh-better-sidebar（v0.24+）；没有它只有设置页可用。

description.en: Queues composer messages sent during DeepSeek peak billing hours and delivers them 3 s after the next off-peak window starts. A dock above the composer shows the countdown with send-now / edit / cancel, the queue survives closing the browser or restarting DSH, and attachments are staged on the host.
description.zh: 高峰时段按发送自动排队，到谷时（半价）开始后 3 秒投递；输入框上方 dock 显示倒计时并提供立即发送/修改/取消，关掉浏览器或重启 DSH 队列不丢，支持附件。

description.en: Adds a tiled board of colour-coded sticky notes to the sidebar: per-row density, pins, search and colour filters, a trash with restore, Markdown export, and note_* tools that read and write the same notes.
description.zh: 在左侧栏加一面可平铺的彩色便签墙：每行 2–5 个或自适应、置顶、搜索与颜色筛选、带恢复的回收站、Markdown 导出；四个 note_* 工具读写同一批便签。

description.en: A settings-tab workshop plus the cordis-plugin-development skill it hands to the agent, for writing DSH plugins against the running host API.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件工坊，附带交给 Agent 的 cordis-plugin-development 技能，基于当前运行的主机 API 编写 DSH 插件。

description.en: Per-turn cost in CNY, with 本轮 / 今日 / 会话 totals shown above the composer. Tokens are priced by model and by the moment they were spent (peak hours and holidays); native DeepSeek search spend can be folded in when the optional audit plugin is installed.
description.zh: 按轮显示本轮花费（人民币），输入框上方常驻「本轮 / 今日 / 会话」合计；按模型与花费时刻计价（含峰谷与节假日），装了可选的搜索审计插件后可并入原生 DeepSeek 搜索费用。

description.en: Read-only observer of native DeepSeek search model calls: appends each call token usage to a JSONL file so accounting plugins can price it. Requests and responses are not modified.
description.zh: 只读观察原生 DeepSeek 搜索的模型调用，把每次调用的 token 用量追加到 JSONL 文件，供统计类插件计价；不修改请求与响应。

description.en: Session Console: a sidebar dashboard over every conversation that shows run state, token spend, cache hit rate, context pressure and a heat score, resolves a plain-language sentence such as "how is the example project going" to the matching session, and dispatches that sentence as a queued task into it. Ships five agent tools (overview, find, tail, dispatch, cancel) over the same data.
description.zh: 会话总控：给侧栏加一个覆盖全部对话的仪表盘，显示运行状态、token 消耗、缓存命中率、上下文压力与热度分数；说一句“示例项目怎么样了”即可定位到对应会话，并把这句话作为任务派发进去。同时提供 5 个 agent 工具（overview / find / tail / dispatch / cancel），与界面共用同一套数据。

description.en: Logic-risk review before rewriting: audit the source, decide each fix, generate several drafts in parallel, and export with a per-draft audit report. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and key - the plugin ships no model and returns 403 until one is configured.
description.zh: 改写前先做逻辑体检：审原文风险、逐条裁决，再并行出多稿，每稿附六维审核报告。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的接口地址与 API Key——插件不内置模型，未配置时生成类接口返回 403。

description.en: A run_tests tool that turns a failing test run into precise context instead of a raw dump. It detects the runner (pytest, jest, vitest, cargo, go, npm), extracts the file, line and assertion of each failure, and stops the loop when failures with an identical signature repeat. Output is decoded so Windows-encoded and non-Latin assertion text stays readable.
description.zh: 提供一个 run_tests 工具，把失败的测试运行变成精确上下文，而不是原始大段输出。自动识别测试框架（pytest、jest、vitest、cargo、go、npm），提取每个失败的 file、line 与断言；同一失败签名反复出现时停止循环。输出经过解码，Windows 编码与非拉丁断言文字都能正常显示。

description.en: LAN access for the harness process: writes the authenticated links for the harness port, one per local IPv4 address, to a token file and registers DSH_LAN_LINK in the shell environment, and can run a gateway on a fixed LAN port that holds the browser session on this machine, so devices need no token; forwarded requests get Host and Origin rewritten for the same-origin guard, and a host-claim marker is injected so the page renders as the full desktop UI instead of remote-visitor mode. Devices are admitted by CIDR, with optional Basic auth.
description.zh: 把当前 harness 进程的局域网访问交给其他设备：把 harness 端口的已认证链接按本机 IPv4 地址写进一个 token 文件，并在 shell 环境注册 DSH_LAN_LINK；可选的网关在固定局域网端口上对外服务，会话凭据留在本机、设备不需要 token，转发时重写 Host 与 Origin 以通过宿主的同源校验，并注入主机声明让页面按完整桌面界面渲染而不是远程访客模式。设备按 CIDR 放行，可选 Basic 认证。

description.en: Open delivered files, changed-file rows and inline file mentions in the system default app with a left click; right-click takeover is configurable: all menus, only where DSH has none, or never. Desktop app only: the Web client has no system-open capability, so clicks stay with DSH.
description.zh: 左键以系统默认程序打开交付文件、改动文件行和对话中的文件提及；右键接管方式可选：全部接管、只接管原生没有菜单的、或完全不接管。仅桌面端可用：Web 端没有系统打开能力，点击仍交给 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Text-to-speech service with Doubao TTS 2.0, Alibaba Bailian and OpenAI-compatible providers and a user-chosen voice; the agent speaks through tts_service_say, split into segments with an optional tone each, and other plugins can reuse ctx.ttsService.
description.zh: 多平台语音合成服务：豆包语音 2.0、阿里云百炼和 OpenAI 兼容接口，音色由用户选；助手用 tts_service_say 说话，可按语气分段、每段带一句语气描述，其他插件可复用 ctx.ttsService。

description.en: Quote selected text from a DSH message into the composer as a blue chip, hover to read the full quote, and remove it with X or Backspace; sent quotes reach the model as a blockquote.
description.zh: 划选 DSH 消息中的文字，右键引用为输入框里的蓝色小块；悬停查看全文，点 ✕ 或按 Backspace 删除；发送后引用以 blockquote 原文交给模型。

description.en: After user setup, guides native subagents toward model preferences by task type, using native model-selection permissions with no extra routing-model calls.
description.zh: 配置模型偏好后，引导原生子 agent 按任务类型选择模型；沿用原生授权，不额外调用路由模型。

description.en: Optional external HTTP API for DSH Desktop, off by default, bound to localhost unless widened, and authenticated with a Bearer token.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的可选外部 HTTP API，默认关闭、默认仅监听本机，扩大监听范围时使用 Bearer Token 鉴权。

description.en: Drive locally installed Codex CLI and Claude Code from DeepSeek Harness through a settings page and agent tools, exposing their sessions, configuration and run state.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动本机安装的 Codex CLI 与 Claude Code，通过设置页与 agent 工具查看会话、配置和运行状态。

description.en: Remembers the model used before quitting and restores it as the startup default.
description.zh: 自动记忆退出前选择的模型，并在下次启动时恢复为默认模型。

description.en: External one-shot subagent provider using the local CodeBuddy CLI over ACP, with background result delivery and steering of running children.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 调用本机 CodeBuddy CLI 的外部一次性子智能体提供者，支持后台结果回传及向运行中的子智能体追加指令。

description.en: Scheduled prompts that open a fresh conversation for every run, with cron, one-time and manual triggers, a per-task working directory, and run history kept out of the sidebar.
description.zh: 定时提示词任务：每次运行新开一个对话，支持 cron、一次性与手动触发，可指定工作目录，运行记录不进左侧列表。

description.en: Expires stale dsh-auth sign-in cookies once the Cookie request header passes 4 KiB, so per-port cookie accumulation can never reach Node's 16 KiB header limit (HTTP 431).
description.zh: 当 Cookie 请求头超过 4 KiB 时，自动过期失效的 dsh-auth 登录 Cookie，避免按端口累积的 Cookie 撑到 Node 的 16 KiB 请求头上限（HTTP 431）。

description.en: Switch installed Rose and Miku themes and customize artwork, background opacity, and phone navigation in DSH settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中切换初音与玫瑰主题，调整人物装饰、背景浓度与手机导航。

description.en: Sets the UI text colour for light and dark themes separately, plus the body font size and the interface typeface, with system Kai/Xing/Li/Song families, four open-source calligraphy fonts and support for importing your own font file.
description.zh: 分别设置深浅主题的文字颜色，并调整正文字号与界面字体：内置楷体、行楷、隶书等系统字体，附带四款开源书法字体，也能导入自己的字体文件。

description.en: Skill management panel inside DeepSeek Harness settings: lists global and per-project skills, marks whether the running DSH actually loads each one, offers one switch that controls both model and slash-command invocation, previews and edits SKILL.md with the chat UI markdown renderer, and creates, imports (folder or zip) or deletes skills into a recovery folder. It only reads and writes the local skill roots (~/.dsh/skills and <project>/.dsh/skills) through its own Host routes behind the DSH Connection trust fence; no telemetry, no outbound requests, no credentials.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的技能管理面板（设置 → 技能）：按全局 / 本项目两组列出技能，标注 DSH 是否真的加载了它；一个启用开关同时控制模型与 /命令 调用；用聊天界面同款 Markdown 渲染器预览并编辑 SKILL.md；支持新建、从文件夹或 zip 导入、删除到回收目录。只读写本机技能目录（~/.dsh/skills 与 <项目>/.dsh/skills），宿主路由走 DSH 的 Connection 信任围栏；不上报数据、无外发请求、不碰凭据。

description.en: Redacts PII in tool-result text before it is logged (error-result metadata is not rewritten), denies read_image and binary/document reads outside allowPaths, provides local privacy_extract, privacy_ocr, privacy_scan and privacy_rehydrate tools (PDF/OCR needs a separately installed local extractor configured through extractCli), and enforces a fail-closed llm/stream egress guard before DSH dispatches any model request.
description.zh: 在工具结果文本写入会话日志前打码（错误结果的元数据不会被改写），拒绝 read_image 及 allowPaths 之外的二进制/文档读取，提供 privacy_extract、privacy_ocr、privacy_scan、privacy_rehydrate 工具（PDF/OCR 需要单独安装并配置 extractCli 的本地提取器），并在 DSH 发出模型请求前执行失败关闭的 llm/stream 出口检查。

description.en: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI "Stellar" agent) model provider for DeepSeek Harness: corrects the cloud gateway request signing to two-round HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the login JWT signature segment, which fixes the 40104 failures the older local-v1 signing produced, and adds points balance, daily check-in, and an in-composer account chip. Reuses the existing local login credential. Cannot be installed alongside anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth — both register the same teleagent provider, and this plugin reuses its credentials and derives its SSE/tool-call parsing from it.
description.zh: 中国电信天翼 AI「星辰超级智能体」(TeleAgent) 模型 provider：把云网关请求签名修正为以登录 JWT 签名段为密钥的两轮 HMAC-SHA256，修复旧版 local-v1 签名导致的 40104 失败，并提供积分余额、每日签到与输入框内账号条；复用已有的本机登录凭据。与 anye-99/dsh-codearts-auth 不能同装——两者注册同一个 teleagent provider；本插件复用其凭据，通用 SSE/工具调用解析亦取自该插件。

description.en: Alt+drag a rectangular box over the DSH conversation to copy the text inside it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中按住 Alt 拖拽矩形选框，复制框内文本。

description.en: Unlock password-protected LabVIEW VI and CTL block diagrams without LabVIEW or Python.
description.zh: 无需 LabVIEW 或 Python，直接解锁受密码保护的 LabVIEW VI/CTL 程序框图。

description.en: Shows real-time Mistral Vibe and API budget usage in the sidebar, with per-model token cost tracking, cached-token spend, and API-key management. Requires a Mistral API key (MISTRAL_API_KEY by default, or a custom apiKeyEnv).
description.zh: 在侧边栏实时显示 Mistral Vibe 与 API 预算使用情况，按模型追踪令牌成本与缓存令牌支出，并支持管理 API 密钥。需要配置 Mistral API key（默认环境变量 MISTRAL_API_KEY，或自定义 apiKeyEnv）。

description.en: QQ (OneBot 11 / NapCat) channel for DeepSeek Harness: bridges QQ private chats and group chats into their own dsh sessions. Ships group guardrails (mention-only, quiet hours, cooldowns, daily quota, peak-hour mute), a tool gate with write-action audit, an outbound filter that stops the model from echoing input tags, voice transcription, media and forwarded-card support, dryRun and usage stats. Forked from dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4. Cannot be installed alongside the upstream dsh-onebot-qq (two QQ channels on one NapCat crash-loop DSH). Private chats answer admins only (an empty admin list means nobody); group chats default to all groups and answer any @-mention, so set groupPolicy to allowlist to restrict who can drive the agent.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 QQ（OneBot 11 / NapCat）通道：把 QQ 私聊和群聊各自接成一个独立的 dsh 会话。内置群聊闸（只认点名、静默时段、冷却、每日配额、工作高峰闭麦）、工具闸与写操作审计、出站过滤器（挡住模型把输入标签当自己的话复读出来）、语音转写、图片与合并转发、dryRun 试运行与用量统计。由 dsh-onebot-qq 0.9.4 分叉而来。不能与上游 dsh-onebot-qq 同装（两个 QQ 通道共用一个 NapCat 会互相抢消息并让 DSH 崩溃循环）。私聊默认只回管理员（管理员名单为空=谁都不回）；群聊默认所有群、被 @ 即应答，任何群成员都能驱动 agent，需要限制请把 groupPolicy 设为 allowlist。

description.en: Map a remote server directory over SSH and SFTP into a controlled local cache workspace, so the model, agent, session and memory keep running on the local machine.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 与 SFTP 把服务器目录映射为受控的本地缓存工作区，模型、Agent、会话与记忆仍在本机运行。

description.en: Edits workspace text files in place inside the DSH file preview, with Monaco highlighting and project-typed completion.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的文件预览面板内直接编辑工作区文本文件，基于 Monaco 提供语法高亮与工程类型补全。

description.en: One-person-company operations SOP for DeepSeek Harness: 8-field company profile, a daily cycle from morning brief through two execution shifts to an evening report, ledger and cash-snapshot conventions, quote/contract shapes, and six red lines with a human-approval outbox.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一人公司运营 SOP：8 字段建公司档案，晨报→两档执行→晚报的日循环，台账与现金流快照口径，报价/合同/日报形状，以及六条红线与待发池人审。

description.en: FreeLLMAPI as a self-contained DeepSeek Harness plugin: the local free-model router ships inside the plugin, so one install gives you a first-class model provider route plus start/stop control — no Docker, no separate checkout.
description.zh: 装好就能用的免费模型路由，内置 FreeLLMAPI，一键启停，直接当模型提供商用。

description.en: 插件
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套文件式记忆，分层存储、会自动遗忘，也能按需找回。

description.en: Pairs a phone console with the current DSH Desktop conversation. Running /phone shows a one-time QR code; after pairing the phone can send messages, approve tool calls, switch models and stop the task, while the desktop stays the only execution host. Requires AgentBridge running locally.
description.zh: 把手机控制台接到当前这条 DSH Desktop 会话：执行 /phone 出现一次性二维码，扫码后可从手机发消息、审批工具调用、切换模型和停止任务，电脑仍是唯一执行端。需本机运行 AgentBridge。
在 Harness 侧栏加个日历面板，还能让 AI 助手帮你安排日程、管理定时任务。

description.en: 7+2 chat harness for DSH, OneBot and optional Codex Peer; privacy-clean distribution
